categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the HTTP server implementation in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unauthenticated resource exhaustion vulnerability where clients trickling request bytes indefinitely occupy HTTP connection slots and block legitimate RPC requests. The PR provides a reproduction showing that trickling one byte every ten seconds easily exhausts connection slots and causes `bitcoin-cli getblockcount` to hang indefinitely.
